scenario.title: Slack: wrong token keeps the form; approval replies stay in the card's thread

human.click: Slack: ask Daimon to connect an MCP server with a token; submit a wrong token in the modal.
human.expect: Rejected without using up the request; card not 'Received. Saving…'.

human.click: Slack: trigger an approval card (publish in a rule-held channel) and Approve.
human.expect: The follow-up stays in the card's thread (#560).

human.click: Slack: as someone other than the asker, press Stop on a running turn.
human.expect: The refusal is visible in the thread, not an ephemeral at channel root (#575).

human.click: Slack: in a DM thread with the bot, reply inside the thread.
human.expect: Answered in that DM thread, not as a new DM (#574).

human.click: Slack: ask for a small CSV attached to the answer in a channel where the app lacks files:write.
human.expect: A visible 'couldn't attach' line naming the missing permission (#561), not a silent loss.

human.click: Slack: run out the channel budget (driver sets 0.01) and mention twice.
human.expect: Visible refusal naming who can top up; Slack shows remaining budget somewhere.
